identitySignals: Agenda names 'The Regents of the University of California (UC Davis, C-STEM)' in Davis, CA; UC Davis news page describes the C-STEM Center as a UC Davis program directed by a UC Davis engineering professor
C-STEM Center develops K-12 math, computing and robotics curriculum, matching OUSD's 'Classroom & academic programs' no-cost services agreement
UC Davis page cites an Oakland school (Roosevelt Middle School) using the C-STEM program
research.notes: Vendor is the UC Regents contracting on behalf of the UC Davis C-STEM Center. c-stem.ucdavis.edu blocks automated fetching (403), so contact details were not captured. Oakland link is via a UC Davis news item about an Oakland school, not a direct OUSD statement.

profile.summary: The C-STEM Center is a University of California, Davis program. It develops math, computing and robotics curriculum and training for K-12 schools. Its materials are used in about 200 schools, mostly in California.

sources.title: UC Davis releases C-STEM Studio: Robotics and computing tools for teachers

review.notes: The cited UC Davis page confirms the C-STEM Center is a UC Davis program (founded 2010) developing math, coding and robotics curriculum, used in about 200 schools mostly in California, including an Oakland school; this matches the agenda's UC Regents (UC Davis, C-STEM) in Davis, CA and a no-cost academic services agreement. The summary is neutral and the website URL appears on the page.
